_rank: For each metric use experiment weight * abs(coefficient) * signed improvement over stored reference / population standard deviation across attempts later ranked. Direction comes only from higher_is_better. Zero-variance metrics contribute zero. Only results in scores_train.json/scores_test.json are ranked.
_scope: Small deterministic 3D kinematic benchmark; not downstream RL, hardware, full 8-hour corpus, or a reproduction of the exact Table II sample distribution. Robot collision hulls are reduced to at most 128 vertices.

object_interaction_kinematics.description: Real OMOMO large-box manipulation retargeted to the 3D Unitree G1. Nominal physical box size is retained. Public train has 20 windows; held-out test has 48 windows from different subjects.

penetration_duration.description: Mean per-window fraction of frames with robot-scene penetration deeper than 1 cm.

max_penetration_cm.description: Mean per-window maximum robot-scene penetration depth in cm; cap 30.

foot_skating_duration.description: Fraction of demonstrated stance-foot events with robot horizontal foot speed above 1 cm/s.

max_foot_skating_cm_s.description: Mean per-window maximum horizontal stance-foot speed in cm/s, including speeds below the skating threshold; cap 300.

contact_preservation.description: Fraction of demonstrated interaction contacts within 3 cm of a target surface: hands for objects, hands/feet for terrain. Deep penetration does not count as contact.

spurious_contact_duration.description: Fraction of clear hand or swing-foot events with robot hand contact or foot support within 1 cm, including penetration.

support_failure_duration.description: Fraction of demonstrated stance-foot events for which the robot foot is farther than 3 cm from the supporting surface, including deep penetration.

pelvis_path_error_cm.description: Mean horizontal pelvis-position error against the scaled human path, cm; cap 100.

pose_error_cm.description: Mean body-relative 15-keypoint pose error against the scaled demonstration, cm; cap 100.

object_interaction_kinematics._scale_note: Reported paper numbers below are preserved for orientation only: different corpus size, contact annotations, robot collision hull reduction, and explicit additional fidelity/support constraints. Final results rows are this gym's measured reference and baseline.
